description: Database schema updates and core authentication infrastructure: Add password reset, Google OAuth, and device tracking fields to users and doctors tables; create user_devices table; install google-auth-library dependency
steps: 1. Add to users table in db/schema.ts: passwordResetRequired (boolean, default false), lastPasswordChangeAt (timestamp), tempPasswordExpiresAt (timestamp), googleId (text, unique)
2. Add to doctors table in db/schema.ts: provisioned (boolean, default false), provisionedBy (text, references users.id), provisionedAt (timestamp)

3. Create user_devices table in db/schema.ts with fields: id (text, primary key, UUID), userId (references users.id, cascade delete), deviceId (text, client-provided UUID), deviceName (text), deviceType (enum: WEB, MOBILE_IOS, MOBILE_ANDROID), userAgent (text), ipAddress (text), lastUsedAt (timestamp), firstUsedAt (timestamp), trusted (boolean, default false), createdAt (timestamp). Add deviceTypeEnum. Add relations to users.
5. Apply schema changes: npm run db:push
6. Verify tables created: Check Neon dashboard or use Drizzle Studio to confirm users has new columns, doctors has provisioning columns, and user_devices table exists
acceptance_criteria: users table has passwordResetRequired, lastPasswordChangeAt, tempPasswordExpiresAt, googleId columns
doctors table has provisioned, provisionedBy, provisionedAt columns
user_devices table exists with all specified columns and enum
npm run db:push completes without errors
verification: Run: npm run db:push and confirm no errors
Check Neon dashboard to verify schema changes applied
Run: npm list google-auth-library to confirm package installed
